reviews.title: Fast, Reliable, and Great Value!
reviews.comment:
I recently upgraded to the Fanxiang S880 NVMe SSD (1TB), and I’m thoroughly impressed. Right out of the box, installation was a breeze—recognized instantly by my system, and I was up and running.
The speed is good... with read/write speeds consistently hitting advertised marks, my boot times, game load times, and file transfers have all drastically improved. This SSD has seriously breathed new life into my PC.
Thermals are also well-managed. Even under sustained workloads, it stays cool and stable with no noticeable throttling. Whether you’re gaming, editing, or multitasking, this drive keeps up with ease.
For the price, the performance-to-cost ratio is outstanding. If you're looking for a high-speed, high-capacity SSD without breaking the bank, the Fanxiang S880 is a no-brainer. I highly recommend it!
reviews.author: Jesus Loves Me

reviews.title: Wicked fast and insanely reliable
reviews.comment: I like that it was easy to install and had the screw included and is very fast with a decent amount of storage for the price I paid. It also doubled my console storage allowing me to have more games downloaded to my console so I don't have to delete stuff off and then re download a game. and I've noticed an increase in loading speeds which is awesome. It's pretty durable as I've had it for a couple of months now with 0 issues. Altogether I highly recommend this this product to anyone thinking of purchasing an internal m2 ssd for any of their devices that can use it, I personally am using it with my playstation 5 and have been thrilled with the performance. I even tell my coworkers about it when they complain about not having enough storage on their playstation 5's. Temperature stays at a decent level haven't had any over heating issues with it either. I'd like to give a shout out for fanxiang for having a top of the line product for a great price point

reviews.title: Perfect to PS5
reviews.comment: I bought this specifically to upgrade my PS5 and I couldn't be happier. The loading speed is even faster than the stock hard drive in some games. The heatsink fits perfectly in the slot without getting in the way. It took 5 minutes to install and the performance is fantastic. Highly recommended if you're looking for reliability.
reviews.author: ANONIMO

reviews.title: Very Impressive SSD
reviews.comment:
I had some trepidation buying an SSD from a company (Fanxiang) I've never heard of but I have heard of very good things about the 3D NAND chips from Yangtze Memory Technologies Corp (YMTC) which is supposedly used in the SSD so I was very interested in trying it out.
Wow!  I am super impressed!  The SSD itself looks just as well made as other better known brands and I appreciated that it came with a tiny screw and screw driver in the kit.
I migrated my Dell XPS desktop from a smaller SK Hynix PC801 NVMe 512GB SSD to the larger 2TB Fanxiang S880 SSD.  While they both have approximately the same rated speed, my computer actually feels faster with the new Fanxiang.
CrystalDiskMark gives the following results:
[Read]
SEQ  1MiB (Q=  8, T= 1):  7047.477 MB/s [  6721.0 IOPS] <  1189.05 us>
SEQ  1MiB (Q=  1, T= 1):  5063.660 MB/s [  4829.1 IOPS] <  206.96 us>
RND  4KiB (Q= 32, T= 1):  512.761 MB/s [ 125185.8 IOPS] <  247.49 us>
RND  4KiB (Q=  1, T= 1):  67.996 MB/s [  16600.6 IOPS] <  60.12 us>
[Write]
SEQ  1MiB (Q=  8, T= 1):  6597.671 MB/s [  6292.0 IOPS] <  1266.55 us>
SEQ  1MiB (Q=  1, T= 1):  5464.139 MB/s [  5211.0 IOPS] <  191.74 us>
RND  4KiB (Q= 32, T= 1):  471.844 MB/s [ 115196.3 IOPS] <  277.60 us>
RND  4KiB (Q=  1, T= 1):  265.445 MB/s [  64805.9 IOPS] <  15.35 us>
These are very good results for a Gen 4 NVMe SSD.  The SSD runs very cool (43 C) and so far, I'm extremely happy with my purchase.  It has been running flawlessly in my computer and I hope that it will remain reliable in the long term.
I am now a big fan of Fanxiang and will be using their products when I upgrade my other computers.  It's always exciting when I discover a new brand that I like.
reviews.author: Geemon2008

reviews.title: Great price/performance on this 4TB NVME S880
reviews.comment: I am always upgrading my system and am very picky about the parts I use. They have to perform well and be at a decent price for the performance. This drive was already on my short list and it was on sale during the latest prime days so I picked it up. My system is setup where I have the fastest drive for my OS, then I have a fast drive for my working files and then I have a larger area for larger file/archiving. For reference, The 7119 bench above is actually my c drive and the nvme three is way faster than my mobo can handle, so that bench shows the fastest my computer can go for accessing an pcie4 m2 nvme slot. The other 3 benchmarks are where this item clocked in at. Very awesome speeds! I wanted to consolidate my 1 tb and 2tb nvme drives that I already had into this 4tb drive to minimize parts and give an upgrade in performance across the board which I was able to accomplish. When I did partition this into 2 drives, there was a small performance hit on the write speeds for the smaller 1.5TB partition whereas the larger partition maintained the bench above. The write speed went down to 6100 on the smaller partition. The overall actual size of this drive is 3.76 TB. I am very happy with the performance of this drive even though I have never heard of or used this brand before. I will be getting another one of these in the upcoming months. Performance and price are fantastic for this.
